Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

AppInstallerBaseUri.description: Base URI the MSIX and .appinstaller are published under

BrandedDmg.description: Lay the DMG out with create-dmg (branded background, needs a GUI session)

BumpType.description: Version bump type: major, minor, or patch

Configuration.description: Configuration to build - Default is 'Debug' (local) or 'Release' (server)

MacCertificateBase64.description: Base64 of a Developer ID .p12 to import into a throwaway keychain (CI)

MacCertificatePassword.description: Password of the .p12 passed through mac-certificate-base64

MacInstallerSigningIdentity.description: macOS Developer ID Installer identity used to sign the .pkg

MacNotaryApiIssuerId.description: App Store Connect issuer id for notarytool

MacNotaryApiKeyId.description: App Store Connect API key id for notarytool

MacNotaryApiKeyPath.description: Path to the App Store Connect .p8 private key used by notarytool

MacSigningIdentity.description: macOS Developer ID identity, e.g. 'Developer ID Application: Acme Ltd (TEAMID1234)'

MsixPublisher.description: MSIX Publisher; must be the exact subject of the signing certificate

RequireNotarization.description: Fail the build if notarization cannot be performed (macOS)

RequireSigning.description: Fail the build if signing material is missing instead of producing unsigned artifacts

SnapGrade.description: Snap grade: stable (default for Release) or devel

Solution.description: Path to a solution file that is automatically loaded. Default is src/netrisk.sln

TimestampUrlFallbacks.description: Extra RFC 3161 timestamp URLs (comma separated), tried after the primary

TrustedSigningCertificateProfile.description: Azure Trusted Signing certificate profile name

TrustedSigningEndpoint.description: Azure Trusted Signing endpoint, e.g. https://eus.codesigning.azure.net

WindowsCertificateCsp.description: CSP exposing a cloud-HSM Authenticode key (signtool /csp)

WindowsCertificateFile.description: Path to an Authenticode PFX. Prefer a cloud HSM: file-based keys no longer meet the CA/B baseline

WindowsCertificateThumbprint.description: SHA-1 thumbprint of an installed Authenticode certificate (signtool /sha1)

WindowsSigningMode.description: Windows signing mode: auto (default), none, trustedsigning or signtool
